<noinclude><pagequality level="4" user="Yann" />{{rh||I ÂRA''N''YAKA, 2 ADHYÂYA, 1 KHA''ND''A, 12.|167}}{{rule}}</noinclude><section begin="aranyaka1 adhyaya2" />5. In the second verse (of another Pragâtha) the word {{lang|sa-Latl|suvîryam}}, strength, occurs (Rv. I. 40, 1), and as endowed with the word {{lang|sa-Latl|suvîrya}}, strength, the form of this day is perfect.

6. In the first verse (of another Pragdtha) the word {{lang|sa-Latl|ukthyam}}, to be hymned, occurs (Rv. I, 40, 5). Verily, this day is an uktha, and as endowed with an uktha, the form of this day is perfect.

7. In the (Dhayyâ) verse {{lang|sa-Latl|agnir netâ}} (Rv. Ill, 20, 4) the word {{lang|sa-Latl|v''ri''trahâ}}, killer of V''ri''tra, occurs. The killing of V''ri''tra is a form (character) of Indra, this day (the mahâvrata) belongs to Indra, and this is the (perfect) form of that day.

8. In the (Dhayyâ) verse {{lang|sa-Latl|tva''m'' soma kratubhi''h'' sukratur bhû''h''}} (Rv. I, 91, 2) the word {{lang|sa-Latl|v''ri''shâ}}<ref>Cf. I, 2, 2, 14.</ref>, powerful, occurs. Powerful is a form (character) of Indra, this day belongs to Indra, and this is the (perfect) form of that day.

9. In the (Dhayyâ) verse {{lang|sa-Latl|pinvanty apa''h''}} (Rv. I, 64, 6) the word {{lang|sa-Latl|vâ''g''inam}}, endowed with food, occurs. Endowed with food is a form (character) of Indra, this day belongs to Indra, and this is the (perfect) form of that day.

10. In the same verse the word {{lang|sa-Latl|stanayantam}}, thundering, occurs. Endowed with thundering is a form (character) of Indra, this day belongs to Indra, and this is the (perfect) form of that day.

11. In (the Pragâtha) {{lang|sa-Latl|pra va indrâya b''ri''hate}} (Rv. VI 1 1, 89, 3) (the word {{lang|sa-Latl|b''ri''hat}} occurs). Verily, {{lang|sa-Latl|b''ri''hat}} is {{lang|sa-Latl|mahat}} (great), and as endowed with {{lang|sa-Latl|mahat}}, great, the form of this day (mahâvrata) is perfect.

12. In (the Pragâtha) {{lang|sa-Latl|b''ri''had indrâya gâyata}} (Rv.<section end="aranyaka1 adhyaya2" /><noinclude>{{rule}}{{smallrefs}}</noinclude>
